name: My name is [Skander Garroum](linkedin).
intro: Currently I am investing first checks in robotics companies with [PROTOTYPE](prototype), doing research for our [YouTube channel](youtube), obsessing over how the future gets built on [LinkedIn](linkedin) and [Substack](substack), and running the Climate Solutions community & Substack [Climate Drift](climatedrift).
j1: At 16, I met a founder on a ferry in China
j2: At 19, I exited my first company and asked what just happened
j3: Studied economics → a few frameworks helped, most didn't
j4: Fell hard for data, network theory, and development economics
j6: Joined the Startup Genome Project at Stanford to learn why startups live or die
j7: Helped build product and growth at Compass, a data benchmarking spinout
j8: Compass acquired by Sage, where our team became the AI division
j9: Co-founded [Airy](airy), real-time AI data infrastructure, between Berlin and SF
j10: A few years, a couple of raises, product launches and stories later: Airy sold to the category leader, then to IBM
j11: Co-founded [Climate Drift](climatedrift), my attempt to do something useful about the climate problem
